common.errorSummary: Could not submit. Please check the problems below:
common.network: Could not reach the server. Please try again later.
common.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to use personal features. The calendar, timeline and public iCal feeds do not need an account.

error.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
error.accountNotLinked: This email is already registered with a different sign-in method. Sign in the original way first, then link the new one on your account page.
error.emailNotFound: That service did not share an email address, so it cannot be used to create an account.
error.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are closed right now.
error.oauthFailed: Sign-in with the other service failed. Please try again.
error.steamInvalid: Steam returned unexpected data. Please sign in again.
error.steamVerification: Steam did not confirm this sign-in. Please try again.
error.steamAlreadyLinked: This Steam account is already linked to another account.
error.steamNetwork: Could not reach Steam to verify the sign-in. Please try again later.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.description: All you need is an email and a password. Passwords must be at least {min} characters.
signup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A password manager is a good idea.

error.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error.passwordTooLong: The password must be at most {max} characters.
error.nameTooLong: The display name is too long.
error.closed: New sign-ups are closed right now.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter the email you signed up with. If it belongs to an account, we will send a reset link (valid for one hour, single use).
forgot.sent: Request received. If this email is registered, a reset link will be sent to it.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.success: Your password has been updated. Sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. A reset link works once and is valid for one hour.

account.title: My account
account.signedOutBody: Sign in to see your account settings.
account.name: Display name
account.linkedNone: No other sign-in methods are linked yet.
account.linkedHint: You must keep at least one sign-in method.

error.unlinkLast: This is your only sign-in method, so it cannot be unlinked.
error.notFresh: For your security, sign in again and retry.

mine.title: My collection and records
mine.hint: Lists and play records are your own notes. They are not added to the calendar and do not send reminders.

track.title: Following and calendar
track.hint: Games and events you follow go into your private calendar; your follow list is visible only to you.

steam.title: Steam library
steam.privacyNote: Importing needs your Steam profile and "Game details" to be public. You can switch them back to private afterwards.
steam.privacyHow: Where to find it: Steam profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings → set "My profile" and "Game details" to Public.
steam.imported: Imported {count} games. Matching them against the database now.
steam.unavailable: Steam import is not configured on this site yet.
steam.cooldown: To avoid hammering Steam, please wait about {minutes} min before importing again.
steam.summary: {total} games: {matched} matched, {review} to confirm, {notFound} not found.

error.load: Could not load your library. Please try again later.
error.generic: Import failed. Please try again later.
error.private: Could not read your library: set "Game details" on your Steam profile to Public and try again.
error.cooldown: You just imported. Please try again in a while.
error.unavailable: Steam import is unavailable on this site right now.
error.upstream: Steam is not responding right now. Please try again later.

match.title: Choose the matching game
match.candidatesNone: No close candidates were found. Try searching below.
match.candidatesFailed: Could not load candidates. Try searching below.
match.searchFailed: The search failed. Please try again later.
match.actionsHint: "This is not any game" suits soundtracks, betas and other items the database does not have; it will not be matched automatically again. "Leave it to automatic matching" clears your choice and lets the system match it again.

game.notTracking: Following means getting release and event changes in your private calendar. Adding to a list or logging a play is just your own bookkeeping and does not appear in the calendar.
game.loadError: Could not load your lists and records. Please reload and try again.

list.pageHint: Lists organize games. They are private by default; public lists can be seen by anyone and by search engines, and unlisted lists can only be seen by people who have the share link.
list.pickerHint: Tick a list to put this game in it; untick to take it out.
list.pickerEmpty: You have no lists yet. Create one below.
list.visibilityHint: Public lists show your display name and can be indexed by search engines.
list.createdAndAdded: Created the list "{name}" and added this game.

error.load: Could not load your lists. Please try again later.

list.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? Everything in it is deleted too and this cannot be undone.
list.shareHint: Anyone with this link can see the list. If you generate a new link, the old one stops working immediately.
list.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Please select the link above and copy it.
list.confirmRotate: The old share link stops working immediately. Continue?
list.rotated: The share link for "{name}" was renewed.
list.emptyGames: This list has no games yet. Use "Add to list" on a game page to add some.

public.title: {name} (a list by {owner})
public.unlistedNote: This is an unlisted list: only people with the link can see it.
public.empty: This list has no games yet.

play.reviewVisibilityHint: Nothing shows reviews yet, so only you can see it for now. It will follow this setting once community features open.
play.privateNoteHint: Only you can see this, ever. Up to {limit} characters.
play.confirmDelete: Delete this record? This cannot be undone.

error.load: Could not load your play records. Please try again later.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.note: Counted per record: several records of the same game count separately. A finish date is needed to count as finished this year.

play.empty: No play records yet. Use "Log play" on a game page to add one.

error.summary: Could not submit. Please check these fields:

field.invalid: This is not in a valid format.
field.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
field.before_started_on: The finish date cannot be earlier than the start date.
field.not_in_game: This game is not on that platform.

error.playRecordLimit: You have reached the play record limit. Delete some old records first.
error.listLimit: You have reached the list limit. Delete lists you no longer need first.
error.listGamesLimit: This list has reached its game limit.
error.notFound: That item was not found; it may have been deleted. Please reload and try again.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.followLimit: You are following too quickly (there is a limit per 24 hours). Please try again later.
error.followNotFound: That item was not found; it may have been removed.
error.suspended: Your account is suspended, so you cannot do this.

playerRating.title: Player average
playerRating.notEnough: Not enough players have rated this game to show an average yet.
playerRating.avgTime: Average play time reported by players: {time}
playerRating.note: Based on play records from users of this site, one vote per user, refreshed about hourly.

hint.event: Once followed, this event appears in your private calendar.
hint.group: Once followed, release dates of its games appear in your private calendar.

private.text: You can also subscribe to a private calendar that contains only what you follow.

follows.title: My follows
follows.note: Only you can see your follow list. Nobody else can view it.
follows.empty: You are not following anything in this category yet.
follows.loadError: Could not load your follow list. Please try again later.

mygames.title: My games
mygames.note: Games you follow, own or have collected, sorted by their nearest release date. Only you can see this page.
mygames.followedHint: “Followed” only includes games you follow directly; following a platform, series or company does not expand into a game list.
mygames.loadError: Could not load. Please try again later.
mygames.badRange: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.

feedcal.title: Private calendar
feedcal.intro: An iCal calendar with only the games and events you follow. Add it to Google, Apple or Outlook calendar.
feedcal.secretWarning: This URL works like a password: anyone who has it can see your calendar. Do not share it or post it anywhere public.
feedcal.delay: Calendar apps do not update instantly; Google Calendar usually takes hours to sync.
feedcal.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. The URL is now shown; select and copy it by hand.
feedcal.urlUnavailable: The URL cannot be shown right now (the server key was changed). Please regenerate the URL.
feedcal.lastAccessed: Last read by a calendar app: {date}
feedcal.neverAccessed: No calendar app has read this URL yet.
feedcal.loadError: Could not load your private calendar. Please try again later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Calendar name
settings.includeEventsHint: On: includes events you follow directly and events related to games you follow. Off: the calendar has no events at all, including events you follow directly.
settings.stagesHint: Tick none for the default (full release, early access, unspecified).
settings.platformsHint: Tick none for no platform limit (up to 20).
settings.saved: Settings saved. Calendar apps apply them the next time they refresh.
settings.tooManyPlatforms: You can pick at most 20 platforms.
settings.genresHint: Tick none for no genre limit (up to 20). Genres only affect release dates; events are not limited by genre.
settings.tooManyGenres: You can pick at most 20 genres.

rotate.confirm: After regenerating, the old URL shows an empty calendar and stops working after 30 days; you will need to subscribe again with the new URL. Continue?
rotate.done: A new URL was generated. Subscribe again with it in your calendar app.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.intro: These preferences only affect what you see. Anything you leave unset uses the site default.
settings.loadError: Could not load your settings. Please try again later.
settings.displayNameHint: Public lists and reviews show this name.
settings.localeHint: Used for things like the default language of your private calendar. The site language is still set by the URL and the language menu.
settings.timezoneHint: For example Asia/Taipei. Leave empty for no preference.
settings.regionHint: The region used first when showing release dates. Leave empty to use the site default.
settings.scoresHint: Which sources' scores to show on game pages. The site owner may also limit which sources are available.
settings.scoresNone: No source is selected: game pages will not show scores.
settings.platformsHint: The platforms you play most (up to 20).
settings.platformsFull: Limit reached. Uncheck another platform to pick more.
settings.defaultListVisibilityHint: Used when you create a list without choosing a visibility. Existing lists do not change.
settings.defaultReviewVisibilityHint: Used when you log a play without choosing a review visibility. Existing records do not change.

nav.title: Settings and privacy
nav.hint: Adjust preferences, export your data, or delete your account.

export.title: Export my data
export.intro: Download a copy of your data on this site. The file contains your private notes, so keep it safe.

includes.connections: Linked sign-in methods (type and date only)
includes.lists: Lists and the games in them
includes.plays: Play records (including reviews and private notes)
includes.follows: Followed games, events, platforms, franchises and companies

export.excludes: Passwords, sign-in credentials and your private calendar subscription URL are not included. For accounts without an email, the email field holds a system-generated placeholder and is marked as such.
export.csvHint: CSV files open in a spreadsheet. Each part is a separate file.
export.rateLimited: Too many exports. Please try again later (there is an hourly limit).
export.failed: Export failed. Please try again later.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deleting your account permanently removes your data on this site:

removes.account: Your account, sign-in methods and preferences
removes.lists: All lists and the items in them
removes.plays: All play records, including public reviews and private notes
removes.owned: Your Steam library and match results
removes.calendar: Your private calendar URL stops working immediately (calendar apps will get "not found")

delete.irreversible: This cannot be undone. We recommend exporting your data first.
delete.backups: For disaster recovery, database backups are kept for a while longer (up to about 6 months). They are not used to run the site and expire on their own. See the privacy policy.
delete.noPassword: Your account has no password. For safety, you must have signed in within the last {minutes} minutes before deleting; if it has been longer, sign in again first.
delete.reauthButton: Sign out and sign in again
delete.passwordHint: Enter your password to confirm it is you.
delete.reauthNeeded: You signed in more than {minutes} minutes ago. Please sign in again, then delete your account.
delete.ack: I understand my account and data will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
delete.confirm: Final check: permanently delete your account?
delete.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

deleted.title: Account deleted
deleted.body: Your account and data have been deleted, and you have been signed out. Thanks for using the site.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account is currently suspended. You can still sign in, but you cannot add or change lists, play records, follows, the calendar or settings, and your public content is hidden from other people. You can export your data or delete your account.
